title: CTRL+BLCK Web Extension
description: Designed the CTRL+BLCK Chrome extension — a sleek, distraction-blocking productivity tool with Supabase-powered sync and a clean, focused UI.
summary: CTRL+BLCK is a Chrome extension for blocking distracting sites and tracking focused work sessions, with Supabase-powered sync. I designed and built the whole front-end experience from concept to ship. A calm, minimal dashboard keeps the focus on focus.
highlights: Designed and built the extension UI end-to-end
Supabase-powered sync for blocks and focus sessions
Clean dashboard that keeps remote pros in flow
